tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dzaḥ 'gro la chags pas rjes chags li khri'i ri// brgya stong gcig tu zhu ba'i nus pa'i mtsho// gsang chen gnam gyi dbyings su 'khril gyur pa// 'bum phrag nyin mor byed pa zil gnon 'od// ting 'dzin bye ba snyed du cher brdal ba/ kun gsal khong par shong dka' snang ba'i mtha'// dpag yas mgon po sngon med 'dir byon pa// pad+ma'i rigs rnams kun gyi gtsug gi gnyen// rig pa drag po'i drod kyis sa 'og sa// sa bla dbang por bcas pa'i khengs pa'i gangs// dbang bral chu ru bsgyur ba'i spro bsdu can// thams cad 'gugs byed dza yig lcags kyu che// 'ching byed hūm̐ zhes zhags par 'khyil pa'i byin// dbang du byed pa'i baṃ dngos lcags sgrog gzi// ro mnyam bsgyur byed dril bu chen po'i brjid// dpal chen zhi khro rgyal ba'i phyag rgya bzhi// dpung pas snyems pa'i yid srub rnams bcings nas// 'dod pa'i yon tan kun phrogs sgrub pa po'i// longs spyod chen por sbyor ba'i shugs drag pos// rnal 'byor gnas la gnas pa'i 'byor ba'i dpyid// rnam sras dpal dang dpal der snyam pa kun// 'di na ri rab ri phran bsgrigs pa bzhin// brtags kyin gang la gang gis 'gran med sbyin// de phyir rnam par dad pa'i "$ phyogs kun gyi// yan lag mchog gi zhing du snyim pa yi// me tog 'bus byas brjid kyis lus 'dud pa// khyod zhabs 'khor lo 'degs su sbyar la gus// gang zhig rgyal dbang rnams kyang chos kyi dbyangs// snyan par dgongs nas gsan pa de lta bu// gzhan don g.yel rgyu med pa khyod la ni// yang yang bskul ba'ang de bzhin lags so sems// de phyir khyod snyan bsun 'byin mi 'gyur zhing*// bdag kyang bag med gyur nas ma yin gyi// bstan ched srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa dang*// khams gsum bdag dbang 'du ba'i dngos grub zhu// slong ba thams cad ngo zum mi 'jug pa// khyod min yongs 'du'i dpag bsam gzhan ni su// mchod cing gsol ba btab pas don 'grub pa'i// yid bzhin nor bu'ang nyid ka gnyis pa ci// 'dod kun 'byung ba'i bum pa bzang po'ang*// mkhas pas khyod la snyan ngag byas pa ste// gang khyod rtsol pas bsnyen nus de dag la// phun tshogs kun 'byung rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug go

/khyod kyi mdzad spyod mtho la nye ba med// dma' la mi zhan kun la ma 'drar byams// 'on kyang mngon sum 'tshal lam ma 'tshal ba// rang gi skal ba nyid la gcig tu rag /gal te bdag ni bsod nams zhan dbang gis// khyod kyis 'phral du rjes 'dzin dka' srid kyang*// da ni dad pas gsol btab skad cig rer// bsod nams dpag med skyes kyi thugs rjes gzigs// sngon chad sdig mang bgyis pas bdag nongs na// nongs pa nyid la thugs rje cher 'dzin par// khyod kyi rgyal ba'i spyan sngar dam bcas zhes// bdag gi rna ba'i dbang pos bdud rtsir blangs// de phyir byams pa'i dgung sngon chen po'i klong*// rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i kha rlangs sbyar nas su// sa gsum rma bya'i sde che myos byas nas// dbang sdud 'phrin las sbyar 'di sgrub tu gsol// ces mgon po phyag bzhi pa dbang gi las la bskul ba pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /
